decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
The Council is not satisfied that the proposed demolition and rebuilding of the wall to a much lower height on the north side of Worton Hall would preserve or enhance the historic character of the site and the area, and is not in compliance with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and ENV-B.2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape character).
description: Following approval for conversion of listed building to provide 8 residential units, demolition of greenhouse and works to boundary wall, together with  the erection of 5 two storey dwellings at the rear with associated landscaping and car parking- details submitted pursuant to  Condition 8 (Boundary wall) of approved appeal dated 13/06/07
